widgets_values: Create a photorealistic high-definition vertical 9:16 ancient-style portrait with the theme of serving tea in a stone bridge beside a moonlit water alley. Show one clearly adult East Asian woman with refined enduring features, a soft face, bright clear eyes, fair natural skin texture, and a pure gentle temperament. She looks directly into the lens as if looking softly at the viewer. She wears a moon-white, cream-white, or pale blue-white silk-satin ancient-style dress with real folds, delicate flower-branch embroidery, and flowing cuffs. Her black hair is in a semi-updo with loose strands, a slight night breeze, and restrained white floral, pearl, or jade hair ornaments. Use a high-angle first-person POV close interactive composition: she holds a complete teapot, teacup, or tea bowl up toward the lens near the viewer's eye level; the tea set is in the foreground and her clearly visible face is behind and slightly above it, creating the layered relationship of tea in front and person behind. The action is serving tea, with correctly proportioned spout, handle, cup mouth, natural liquid direction, slender natural fingers, and an elegant gentle gesture. Build a stone bridge beside a moonlit water alley with water reflections, warm lanterns, ancient architecture, night channels, and only a few softly blurred tourists. Mix cool blue night ambience with warm yellow practical lights, moderate background blur, natural lens depth, and soft night shadows. Emphasize the feeling that she is presenting tea directly to the viewer, not a static standing shot. Avoid underage or childlike styling, seductive provocation, flat expression, malformed fingers, distorted tea ware, wrong liquid direction, broken clothing, exaggerated anatomy, plastic skin, greasy face, warped background, watermarks, logos, text, low resolution, cartoon style, and CGI appearance.

widgets_values:
A vertical, portrait-oriented nighttime photograph shows an elegant East Asian-appearing young adult woman positioned slightly right of center beside a waterside courtyard or garden passage illuminated by a bright full moon. The image uses a close-up selfie-like perspective with a dramatic low extension of her arm toward the camera: in the immediate lower foreground she holds a round amber-tinted glass or crystal teapot or covered cup containing a golden beverage. This vessel is out of focus due to shallow depth of field, has a circular shape with a small domed lid and delicate base saucer, catches orange-yellow candlelike reflections, and features a decorative branch or floral relief motif on its outer surface. Her slender hand wraps around the handle area from below, occupying much of the bottom-center portion of the frame, creating pronounced foreground layering.

In the central-right area, the woman's upper body faces forward with her head turned toward the camera. She appears slim, with fair to light-medium skin tone, oval face shape, straight nose, defined brows, almond-shaped brown eyes looking calmly into the lens, softly blushed cheeks, subtle eyeliner, long lashes, gentle highlighter on the nose and cheekbones, muted rose lipstick, and faint freckles or small beauty marks visible on the forehead and facial skin. Dark loose wisps of hair fall around her temples and cheeks, partly veiling one side of her face. Her black hair is styled half-up with volume at the crown and adorned with ornate floral hair accessories: pearl-like clusters, small blossoms, metallic gold-toned pieces, jade ornaments, dangling bead chains, and thin tassels extending down the side of her hair near her neck.

She wears flowing moon-white, cream-white, or pale blue-white traditional hanfu-inspired clothing made of semi-translucent embroidered fabric. The garment includes wide draped sleeves over darker inner trim, with visible floral appliqué-like decoration on the shoulder and chest area featuring vine shapes, leaf patterns, small flowers, stitched lines, and tiny sparkling embellishments. The neckline forms soft overlapping layers, exposing the collarbones and part of one shoulder. The textile texture feels lightweight and gauzy, catching cool silver-blue moonlight and warm amber reflections along folded edges.

Behind her, the left side of the image contains a carved wooden railing and post, dark bronze or aged wood tones, rising diagonally upward and backward through misty air. The railing sits partially submerged visually among glowing water reflections and atmospheric smoke. Above and beyond it, the moon dominates the upper-left quadrant as a large creamy white circular disc, surrounded by cloudy blue-gray skies and scattered clouds; its halo creates strong backlighting, silhouettes parts of trees, and casts shimmering highlights across rippling water in the lower-left and middle distance. Willow-like green leaves hang densely across the upper-left corner and along the top edge, forming irregular natural borders in dark olive, moss-green, and shadowed charcoal colors. Behind them are blurred pavilion-style rooflines with curved eaves, suggesting classical East Asian architecture rendered in realistic but painterly fashion.

Near the center and left-middle background, multiple temple rooftops recede into soft-focus darkness beneath the branches. Their roofs have tiered ridgelines, small finial tips, and warm lantern points underneath. Mist drifts between structures and above the water channel, giving the space a humid, late-night ambience. In the center background, an arched stone bridge or building spans horizontally, lit warmly from within or below, with repeated window openings resembling lattice frames arranged in rows across its facade. Below the bridge, calm canal-like water reflects streaks of yellow lamplight, silver moonlight, and smoky gray highlights.

On the right side, several cylindrical hanging lanterns with warm amber cores and reddish-orange shade exteriors line the passageway. They are mounted along poles or brackets, producing repeated pools of warm light aligned in perspective down the alley. One prominent lantern hangs just right of center behind the woman's hair ornament and shoulder, partially obscured by hair strands and foliage, while more lanterns continue deeper along the right edge and lower-right path. Stone steps or ledges run alongside these lamps, with rough, uneven, worn textures highlighted by alternating bands of shadow and reflected flame-colored light.

The far right background consists of closely packed timber walls, beams, balconies, columns, and slatted windows in deep brown, blackened walnut, copper, burnt sienna, beige, and crimson hues. Some panels show patterned latticework or painted decorative motifs, including stylized bird-and-flower imagery on screens or wall plaques. Thin vapor rises along the right margin and curls past the building facades. Near the lower-middle ground, pink petals or small floating fragments scatter over the water, adding motion cues despite the otherwise still pose. Tiny sparkles resemble suspended dust, moisture, fireflies, or rain droplets throughout the air, especially around the manor entrance where candles illuminate his profile.

The entire composition combines extreme proximity intimacy with environmental storytelling: the sharply detailed face anchors the scene, while the foreground drink, railing, garments, rooftops, willow leaves, fog, water, lanterns, and architecture gradually dissolve through shallow focus. Lighting mixes cool moonlit blues from the left/back with warm lantern yellows and oranges from the sides, producing strong chiaroscuro across her skin, hair ornaments, sleeve creases, stone textures, and the liquid-filled glass. The shot resembles a high-resolution editorial or cinematic promotional portrait, likely staged outdoors or digitally crafted with hyperrealistic photographic rendering, macro foreground blur, selective focus, rich atmospheric particles, and romantic historical costume styling.
